tasks.short: Job development and placement with employers

steps.what: Participate in job development and placement programs with colleagues.
Contacting prospective employers about work this client could do.
Placing clients in jobs once the employer and the client agree.
Evaluating the success of those placements after the client starts.

tasks.design: She joins the placement program with colleagues, calls prospective employers, places the client when both sides agree, and judges whether that placement holds. No tool is added. The design does not file a placement letter, send an introduction, raise an alert, or fill a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The employer and the client have to agree in the conversation. A stored match cannot do that.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that conversation, so no tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: The employer can still refuse, and the client's limits are not a score.
tasks.human_edge: She can hear whether the job will hold for this client.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still spends this time on the placement conversations and on judging whether the job holds.

reach.role: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
reach.task: Judge whether a learner is ready to start a job
reach.learn: How a placement fails after the first month, from the employer's account and the client's.

evidence.claim: GDPR article 22 forbids a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects concerning the person.
Health data is a special category of personal data under GDPR article 9.
EU AI Act Annex III 5(a) covers eligibility for public assistance and services, including healthcare, by or for public authorities, and 6(d) covers re-offending risk.
Contacting an employer and placing a client are live conversations in a typical company rehabilitation practice, unless that company requires a letter.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

Clients and prospective employers are outside this company. Contacting them and placing the client are live speech, and no placement letter or introduction is filed or emailed, so there is no commit or send to gate.
The placement aim comes from the colleague meeting in the first step. No employer list, match score, or opening catalogue is used, and no machine step reads one.
Client rehabilitation facts are health data. This design does not score eligibility or re-offending, and it does not treat this employer as a public authority.
Evaluating the placement is her judgement. She does not write that judgement into a record in this task.
unknowns: Whether this company requires a written placement letter to the employer.
Whether the client is an employee of this company or a person the company serves.
research_questions: Does this company place a client by a live agreement, or does someone file a letter first?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week where she meets the placement colleagues, calls two employers, places one client in person, and judges that placement later, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.short: Manage budgets and authorize service payments

steps.what: Manage budgets by reading the open service balance.
Decide which case service allocations this balance can bear.
Direct colleagues on those service allocations before anything is filed.
Authorizing expenditures and payments on the allocation version she files.

tasks.design: She reads the open balance in the {ERP}, decides the service allocation, tells colleagues, and files allocation authorization v1 herself. That filed version is the only commit, and she gates it before it stands. The design does not send a payment, raise an alert, or fill a sheet; the finance team pays later.
tasks.previous_blocker: The amount has to match the service this client can use. A calculator cannot know that.
tasks.enabler_now: The {ERP} already shows the balance she reads. No new tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong amount or a wrong service harms the client and the budget.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which service the client will actually use.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the balance, chooses the allocation, tells colleagues, and files the authorization herself.

reach.task: Authorise a one-off care cost for a client
reach.learn: Which service the client can actually use before the amount is filed.

evidence.claim: GDPR article 22 forbids a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects concerning the person.
Health data is a special category of personal data under GDPR article 9.
In a mid-size company the counselor files an internal authorization, and the finance team pays the provider later.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The service balance is the open amount the finance team already posted on the cost centre in the {ERP}. The fields she reads are cost centre, remaining amount, and period. If any field is missing she asks the finance team and does not authorize. That reading is her first step and is not treated as free.

Allocation authorization v1 is an internal record. Before it stands she checks that the client, the service, the amount, and the period match the allocation she decided. The finance team pays the provider later. This task does not send a payment to a bank, a supplier, or a client.
Directing colleagues is spoken and files nothing. No alert and no sheet are produced.
The allocation is not made by a model. Client service facts are health data.
unknowns: Whether spend above a limit needs a manager's signature besides hers.
Whether the authorization is a screen entry or a signed form.
research_questions: Who else must sign before the finance team can pay this allocation?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week where she reads the balance, chooses one allocation, tells colleagues, and files that authorization herself, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.short: Confer on and implement rehabilitation programs

steps.what: Read the client limits before the rehabilitation programs are discussed.
Confer with occupational therapists and other professionals on staff.
Confer with physicians and psychologists who treat this client outside.
Develop client rehabilitation programs from those two conferrals.
Implement that rehabilitation program with the client in person.

tasks.design: She reads the client limits, confers with on-staff therapists, confers live with the client's physicians and psychologists, decides the program, and carries it out with the client. No program version is filed or emailed, and the talks are not recorded. The design does not draft a note, send a program, raise an alert, or fill a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The program depends on what the clinicians and the client will do. A draft cannot settle that.
tasks.enabler_now: The conferral stays live, so no note tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: Clinicians can disagree, and the client's week may not match the program.
tasks.human_edge: She holds the disagreement in the room and changes the program with the client.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still confers, decides the program, and carries it out with the client.

reach.task: Plan a return to ordinary activity with the treating clinician
reach.learn: What the clinician will and will not do in the client's week.

evidence.claim: Health data is a special category of personal data under GDPR article 9.
Recording staff conversations needs works council consent under WOR article 27(1)(k) and (l).
UK social workers found invented suicidal ideation and an invented food detail in AI notes, and one council's own check was less positive than the vendor evaluation.
A rehabilitation program is agreed with the clinicians and the client in conversation, and a company counselor does not hand that program to a model.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The client file already exists from intake. She reads the hour limit, the tasks the client cannot do, and any clinician names. If a field is missing she asks in the conferral. No machine step uses those fields, and the reading stays in the first step.

Occupational therapists and other professionals on staff are colleagues, so that conferral is internal talk. Physicians and psychologists who treat the client, and the client, are outside. Both outside talks are live speech.
No program version is filed or emailed, so there is no commit or send to gate. The talks are not recorded, so works-council consent for recording is not triggered.
No generated program note is written. Client facts are health data.
unknowns: Whether the physicians and psychologists are employed by this company.
Whether a written program must be filed, and whether that file is a clinical dossier kept for twenty years.
research_questions: Does this company employ the physicians, or are they the client's own clinicians?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a case where she reads the limits, confers with the on-staff therapist and the outside physician, decides the program, and carries it out with the client, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

steps.what: Hear how rehabilitation counselors and staff handled the hard case.
Decide what guidance that case now needs.
Supervise those rehabilitation counselors and staff on the next step.

tasks.design: She listens, decides the guidance, and tells the counselors and staff the next step in the room. No note is filed, and nothing is recorded. The design does not send a message, raise an alert, fill a sheet, or score the staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: The guidance depends on what the counselor just did. A list of cases cannot supply it.
tasks.enabler_now: The supervision stays a conversation, so no tool is added.
tasks.still_hard: She has to judge whether to take the case back.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the counselor and decides in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still listens, decides, and tells the counselors the next step.

reach.role: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
reach.learn: When to stop a counselor and take the case back.

evidence.claim: Recording staff conversations needs works council consent under WOR article 27(1)(k) and (l).
Supervising counselors in a company is a live conversation with colleagues, and a note is not part of every supervision hour.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The counselors and staff are colleagues. Supervision is spoken direction. No supervision note is filed and no message is sent, so there is no commit or send to gate.
She does not start from a case list or a dashboard. The counselor tells her the case in the room. No structured case row is required, and no machine step reads one.
Staff conversations are not recorded, so works-council consent for recording is not triggered. No camera and no performance score are added.
unknowns: Whether this company requires a supervision note after the conversation.
Whether every person she supervises is an employee of this company.
research_questions: Does this company expect a written supervision note, or is the hour only spoken?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a supervision hour where she listens, decides, and tells the counselor the next step, no step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

role.altitude: She still places clients, authorizes services, confers with clinicians, and supervises counselors. No tool takes those acts.
reach: A career counselor learns which placements failed after the first month, from her account of the employer and the client.
A healthcare social worker learns which service cost she will and will not authorize before finance pays.
skills_to_grow: Judge a placement from the client's first weeks at work, not from a match score.
Refuse a payment, an alert, or a sheet that files itself.
Refuse a recording or a generated program note.
role.ambitious_version: The same counselor still places, authorizes, confers, and supervises. No letter, payment, or program is sent in her place.
